findings.title: The human in a failing account
findings.claim: The universal human named here can be heard inside a failing account: counted wealth and a belief in permanence stand against the short duration that later makes worldly life seem like an hour, so loss becomes a balance that apparent accumulation cannot secure.
findings.mechanism: The focus names humankind as the subject and places that subject within general diminution. The wider hoarding-and-counting image supplies an account scene, while the brief-duration passage gives its temporal measure; those triggers return through both the focus human and loss words.
findings.reader_payoff: A flat statement of loss becomes a temporal valuation: what is accumulated can still fail to preserve the life being spent.
findings.containment: The commercial ledger is a contextual resonance carried by the ordinary human and loss readings. The focus does not say that every person literally trades, hoards wealth, or consciously calculates a balance.

epistemic.reason: The focus branches and trusted publication support are explicit; the added account mechanism is a bounded inference from exact wider Arabic surfaces whose target morphology is not supplied.

findings.title: Loss as a losing transaction
findings.claim: The loss word also admits the result of a losing transaction: principal can be diminished, or expected gain can fail to arrive, while the wider account passages make time spent and wealth counted part of the scene.
findings.mechanism: The focus loss noun carries the commercial-loss facets. Hoarded and counted wealth, imagined permanence, and the later compression of worldly duration into an hour act as independent triggers; they make the transaction image materially alter how the focus condition is pictured.
findings.reader_payoff: Loss appears as a bad exchange with time: apparent accumulation does not guarantee a return.
findings.containment: This commercial facet coexists with general diminution. The focus grammar names a state of loss and does not force every reader into a literal market or a single cause.

epistemic.reason: The commercial branch is explicitly registered and supported by a trusted publication; the wider account connection is a contextual analogy, with external morphology unavailable.

findings.title: Loss as short measure and unpaid due
findings.claim: The loss state can also be heard as the result of short measure: the wider verses explicitly name giving others less than their due, while the context's truth/right language supplies both a standard and an owed claim.
findings.mechanism: The focus loss noun meets exact wider Arabic forms for shorting a balance and under-measuring. The contextual al-haqq carrier, as attributed in the supplied reader walks, contacts those measures as truth, due obligation, and a particular right; the relation returns to خُسْرٍ as a possible state produced by failed measure.
findings.reader_payoff: Loss gains an ethical edge: a person may be diminished while another is also denied what should have been delivered.
findings.containment: The focus is an indefinite noun naming a loss-state, not a verb accusing each person of cheating. Short measure is a grounded wider consequence and one coexisting reading; the external verses' target morphology is not supplied.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch is registered and trusted publication support is present; 83:3, 55:9, and 26:181 supply exact surfaces, while the contextual right/truth branch carriers remain attributed at ayah level.

findings.title: The perceiving human can miss the shortfall
findings.claim: The human who can notice may still fail to recognize loss: one wider passage shows the human seeing himself as self-sufficient before overstepping, while another makes him a witness against himself. When the loss also takes the social form of short measure, the focus can be heard as a deficit that truthful, trusted counsel helps bring into view.
findings.mechanism: The focus perception branch on al-insān contacts the self-sufficiency and self-witness images; the focus loss and short-measure branches contact the exact wider under-measure wording. The supplied exception's trust and al-haqq carriers, together with mutual counsel, provide a second route by which the condition can be recognized and corrected.
findings.reader_payoff: The diagnosis becomes perceptual as well as social: loss can be present before its subject sees it, and truthful exchange can make it visible.
findings.containment: This reading does not make outside advice necessary in every case. The self-witness passage keeps inward recognition live beside mutual counsel; neither the focus nor the connections say that al-insān lexically means 'the perceiver.'

epistemic.reason: The focus perception and loss branches are registered; the wider target Arabic gives surface triggers but no target morphology, and the trust/truth context branches are carried from attributed reader-walk evidence.

findings.title: Human companionship inside loss
findings.claim: The human can also be heard as a being capable of nearness and ease with others. Wider passages count severed bonds among the losing condition and describe people mutually urging one another toward patience and mercy, so the focus verdict gains a relational dimension and a shared form of repair.
findings.mechanism: The companionship facet of al-insān meets two independent wider scenes: broken ties are explicitly named among those who lose, while mutual exhortation to patience and mercy supplies a reciprocal act. Those scenes return through the focus human and its loss relation.
findings.reader_payoff: Loss includes estrangement from human closeness, and its counter-movement can be carried together.
findings.containment: The focus still states a general condition; it does not say that every person is lonely or that social support is the only cause or remedy. A retrospective source also suggests a ṣabr/B003 suretyship gloss, but that branch has no registry record and is not asserted here.

epistemic.reason: The focus companionship branch is registered and the wider verses give exact surfaces; the context exhortation branch is nominated and retained at ayah-level attribution.

findings.title: Loss as an enclosing pressure
findings.claim: Because the focus places the human in loss, the condition can also feel enclosing: the wider description of human life in hardship and the shared urging toward patience make pressure and patient holding visible beside the same focus phrase.
findings.mechanism: The focus preposition fī gives loss an enclosing relation; the wider hardship phrase repeats an inhabited condition, while the mutual-patience passage supplies an independent act of endurance and counsel. The contact changes the loss-state from a bare deficit to a condition lived under pressure.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive loss as something surrounding a life, with patient mutual support as a different way of holding within strain.
findings.containment: The hardship passage explicitly supplies hardship, not loss itself. This is a contextual analogy, not an equation of every hardship with loss or a claim that patience removes the focus condition.

epistemic.reason: The focus general-deficit branch and the cross-surah hardship/patience surfaces are supplied; the context severe-trouble facet comes through legacy attribution.

branch_activations.activation: Focus containment relation meets a wider lived-hardship scene and a communal practice of patience; together they make the loss-state perceptible as pressure surrounding a life.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Kayıp, insanın içinde bulunduğu çevreleyen bir baskı olarak da duyulur; sabır ve karşılıklı öğüt başka bir tutunma biçimi sunar.

findings.mechanism: The focus's general-deficit branch meets the exception in 103:3; wider passages pair faith and sound action with flourishing and repeat mutual counsel to patience and mercy. Those independent contexts return through the focus loss word and make the exception's response newly legible.
findings.reader_payoff: Loss is still the focus claim, now heard as a diagnosis whose wider field also names ways of answering it.
findings.containment: The packet does not say that the four exception elements are an exhaustive causal explanation of every loss, nor does the wider parallel replace the focus assertion. The source's basmala/mercy frame is not used as a global trigger.

epistemic.reason: The focus branch is registered; the exception and two exact wider parallels are present, while the source synthesis remains legacy-unbound and the causal relation is interpretive.

epistemic.reason: The focus measure branch and due-right nomination are supplied; patience/holding is attributed from the retrospective source and exact wider context, not a focus lexical gloss.

epistemic.reason: The packet supplies the exact wider Arabic and a connection nomination but no external target morphology; the purpose-to-loss relation is the writer's bounded inference.
